title: Houston finds hidden stones and senses their energy

tellings.quote: his room a little bit later and he had lined these three stones up on his bedside table

plain: A mother in Atlanta, Georgia, named Katie says that her son Houston found stones that had been hidden from him and could sense their energy. She says that when she went into his room a little later, he had lined the three stones up on his bedside table. She told it in connection with a documentary called the Telepathy Tapes, about children said to have mind-reading abilities.
